candidates.name: Kaposi sarcoma
support_spans: a single, well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque densely composed of telangiectasias
candidates.why: The patient's skin lesion is consistent with Kaposi sarcoma, which is characterized by telangiectasias and blanchable red plaques.

candidates.name: angioma
support_spans: Discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels were observed, with superficial, small lobules of small-caliber vessels
candidates.why: The histopathological findings of small-caliber vessels and superficial lobules are consistent with angioma.

candidates.name: Kaposi sarcoma
support_spans: KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R identified as the only somatic mutation
candidates.why: The somatic mutation in KDR (VEGFR2) suggests an abnormality in angiogenesis, which is a key mechanism in Kaposi sarcoma.
